result.title: Bayesian Model Discovery with Language Models: Closing the Loop between Hypotheses and Experiments
result.summary: Scientific model discovery requires proposing candidate models of an unknown system and designing experiments that discriminate among them. However, LLM-based approaches typically rely on in-context learning to predict outcomes and select experiments, lacking explicit model evaluation to systematically guide hypothesis search, while Bayesian approaches enable principled model comparison but are confined to a predefined candidate set which results in limited search spaces. To this end, we introduce BMD, which closes the loop between LLM-driven hypothesis generation and Bayesian experimental design. Specifically, an LLM proposes model families, while a numerical engine fits their parameters, weighs them by model evidence, and averages their predictions. Then, BMD chooses the next experimental conditions by maximizing the joint expected information gain over families and their parameters, while feeding the updated beliefs and residual diagnostics back to the LLM to guide its next proposals. Across four scientific discovery benchmarks, BMD achieves lowest final prediction error than in-context learning and LLM-based scientific agents while recovering exact functional forms more often, with ablations supporting numerical feedback and the joint objective.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BMD 框架，用 LLM 生成候选模型族、数值引擎拟合参数并按模型证据加权，再以联合期望信息增益选择下一步实验条件，同时把更新后的信念与残差诊断反馈给 LLM 引导下一轮假设，在四个科学发现基准上取得更低预测误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「信念更新—信息增益选实验—反馈引导假设」的闭环，可能为 LVR 中证据获取（LOOK）与停止决策（STOP）的价值评估提供一个可核查的形式化视角，但属远领域线索，需人工核查迁移可行性。
